scripts.build: tsx scripts/db-guard.ts build && prisma migrate deploy && next build
scripts.db:migrate: tsx scripts/db-guard.ts not-production && prisma migrate dev
scripts.test:e2e:setup: npm run db:guard:test && npm run db:reset:test && npm run db:migrate:test && npm run db:seed:test && npm run import:content:test
scripts.db:migrate:test: dotenv -e .env.test -- tsx scripts/db-guard.ts test && dotenv -e .env.test -- prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed:test: dotenv -e .env.test -- tsx scripts/db-guard.ts test && dotenv -e .env.test -- tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.import:content:test: dotenv -e .env.test -- tsx scripts/db-guard.ts test && dotenv -e .env.test -- tsx prisma/import-content.ts
scripts.db:reset:test: dotenv -e .env.test -- tsx scripts/db-guard.ts test && dotenv -e .env.test -- prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed
